reviews.title: Cancellation failure thus holding people and their money hostage
reviews.text: Somehow, thinking this was a different app I signed up for a week trial. As soon as I realized I immediately tried to cancel to prevent further charges, it is extremely difficult to find out how to cancel, then suddenly after sign up and giving my information went so smoothly, the website glitches as well as stating repeatedly that “something went wrong, please try one more time” when selecting cancellation. After approximately thirty times I contacted their support email. If this is not handled within a few days I will file fraud charges with my cardholder. Ridiculous and underhanded but, unfortunately typical.

reviews.title: So many coins just to watch one episode?!
reviews.text: To watch one episode you have to pay 100 coins that’s absurd and the ads only give 25 per ad meaning I’m watching more ads then the actual series like at least make us get 50 coins per ad or even better make the price of each episode 50 coins and keep the 25 ads thing.

reviews.title: Content, great – but coins hard to get
reviews.text: The content on this one is better quality than a lot of others. But the annoying thing is that it’s harder to get coins, and they push you to pay to see more than the first few episodes. It’s far too expensive. If the subscription was cheaper, I’d be more tempted, but it’s just too much.

reviews.title: Great storyline but always unfinished
reviews.text: The story lines are really really good for the most part BUT most are unfinished with no clear timeframe on when they will be updated or finished.  That makes it extremely frustrating because it’s just cliff hanger city and since you don’t know when stories will be finished you have to maintain a membership or get coins. Also the library isn’t as extensive as similar apps (drama box, DramaWave , ReelShort) that offer a lot more completed stories, though in all fairness Muse scenes do seems to be a lot less choppy than the aforementioned apps. If you’re a fan of steamy stories the scenes are pretty watered down so I would temper your expectations in that department. I will also say that while their customer service can be slow, the results are satisfactory.

reviews.title: VIP Doesn’t mean you get episodes
reviews.text: Great story, I’d say stories, but can watch only 90 seconds (which is an “episode”) at a time of 1 story, so far, as I am trying this out, and then you either pay big $ to watch anything or watch ads worth very little coinage, about 5-20 as far as I can see. Each unlock-able episode  is approx 100 coins. Yeah. You’re gonna be watching TONS of ads. I paid for VIP thinking (wrongly) it would unlock episodes. Nope. So I cancelled it immediately. I’m writing this in all honesty, and to get 200 coins. Would give this way more stars, but pretty disappointing as an app.

reviews.title: THIS IS FRAUD
reviews.text:
This app is completely fraudulent and they are using bots to create high ratings. 

I purchased a week long subscription last night through my apple account. Went to watch content this morning and was logged out of my account and told my email and password were incorrect. I tried resetting my password and never received a reset link. 

I contacted support to ask for a password reset link. They made me provide a screenshot of the receipt then sent a follow up question asking for my credit card number so they could confirm I had an account. When I told them I’d be reporting their company as fraud a new CS agent asked if I had tried the password reset link. It’s just a big game to swindle as much money out of the customer as possible.

reviews.title: Don’t Bother!
reviews.text: This app is obviously a lazy, joke of an attempt to get you to spend money on its slop. It gets incredibly hard and increasingly frustrating to obtain coins as you go on, and even when you eventually do and are able to unlock the next episodes, they are often as short as 20 seconds. A waste of time if I’ve ever seen one, lol. Naturally, what was I expecting? My curiosity got the better of me, but I’m telling you now if you’re, too, curious, don’t bother! And it’s all for inconsistent AI stories anyway, you are so much better off finding something else to watch, I promise. I’m only giving it 2 stars instead of 1 because apparently reviews with that number are harder to remove. We’ll see if this holds up 😹

reviews.title: Incompetente stories
reviews.text:
Fed up. I subscribed because the image quality looked great and the stories seemed creative. £19 a week, yet not a single drama has a proper ending. Every single one ends with “to be continued,” clearly expecting people to keep paying without ever delivering a complete story.

I also watched another drama where the script was decent, but the visuals barely matched what was happening. Characters, scenes, and actions kept changing in ways that didn’t make sense. Is this a joke?

reviews.title: Much too slow - Don’t waste your time!
reviews.text:
I left a positive review initially, until I realised none of the stories are finished. It takes weeks, if not months to add new episodes, and then you get a couple of minutes worth. Takes the enjoyment out of watching as you’ve forgotten what you’ve seen by the time the next are released. Will be deleting the app. Gutted as I really wanted to see how the ones I’ve been watching will end - eventually! 
Whoever thought this way of producing content was a good idea needs firing. Beyond disappointing!!! 
Would give 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: They say on the app they will give you 200 credits to give a review but they don’t!
reviews.text: They say on the app they will give you 200 credits to give a review but they don’t! So if you are writing a review in hopes they will.. I wouldn’t bother. You can barely watch anything without paying money. Would be better if the free options of watching adds etc let you watch more. The ads constantly freeze so you don’t get coins that way and would need to watch so many to even be able to watch an episode. £20 A week is more than people pay for Netflix etc it’s crazy.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Some of the AI projects are amazing, don’t get me wrong! The AI Short “swimming to win my bullies love” is amazing and is the reason I paid for membership. Unfortunately, they haven’t even realised the full season. Episodes say “coming soon”. This is rare for this type of app. The more I looked into it the more I found they have a lot of unfinished series! Most be a ploy to get people to extend their memberships! Well, I won’t be subscribing till they have full series, and I suggest you don’t either. Anyone interested in watching swimming to win my bullies love should hold off because you don’t get an ending at all.

reviews.title: Frustrating experience with forced subscription issues.
reviews.text:
I enjoy the series on this app as they are very engaging and addictive. However, after reading other reviews, I became aware of concerns regarding subscriptions not being easily cancelled, which has put me off subscribing.

Additionally, I have experienced issues with the advert-based viewing option. When reaching the point of watching adverts to earn coins and continue episodes, the app tends to freeze. This makes it difficult to proceed unless a subscription is purchased, which feels somewhat intentional.

Overall, due to these issues and the user experience surrounding access to content, I have rated this app 1 star.

reviews.title: Hmm, could be better
reviews.text: I love the unique vertical drama they have to offer but… it’s so expensive, especially if you don’t have the funds and they offer you so little coins for watching ads, although fair but honestly if you offer so little then at least offer more ad chances to watch. You can earn some coins but they’re not even barely enough to watch a series.

reviews.title: Can’t log in or cancel subscription I didn’t buy.
reviews.text: So I had used muse ai once and I had just bought some coins for a series but then I didn’t enjoy the content at all so I just deleted the app. I NEVER signed up for a subscription from this app but I just got charged 23 dollars today from them. I tried downloading the app again so that I could cancel whatever was charging me but when I tried signing in I didn’t have a password because they never asked me to make an account with them. So I tried my Apple account and everytime I tried to send a password reset email to my iCloud account it never sent. My inbox is still empty after I tried 5 times and I made sure to refresh and close my app a couple of times. I don’t see this subscription listed anywhere, not on my App Store, not on rocket money, not on my Apple account, and if I got into the app maybe I’d be able to delete it. But now I’m stuck getting charged 23 dollars everyweek. Yes every week, I only bought the small amount of coins a week ago before I got charged the 23 dollars.

reviews.title: On the defense
reviews.text: I kept seeing ads on facebook for a show that looked interesting called (the lycan kings defect daughter) finally I downloaded my muse. It is like other apps that I have tryed before again it cost a lot of coin to watch one episode and you run out of the free coins quickly with just 1-3 episodes and than your leaving hanging unless you pay. No thanks. As for the details so far not that impressed seems the story keeps bouncing from one thing to another and missing parts in between.  So I am just gonna say so far really not impressed will try 1-2 more different shows but if like the first one than will probably not keep the app.

reviews.title: Not a single drama is finished
reviews.text: Don’t waste your time or money. None of the AI stories are finished. Most are less than 10 minutes and jump around to not make sense. The AI they are using cannot pronounce words correctly and characters are either crying or yelling with Snapchat filter faces. The very few human vertical dramas they offer are all old ones everyone has seen a million times elsewhere and don’t have attractive people in them. I feel scammed and ripped off because what they advertised is all lies and you don’t have any complete AI stories to watch. The very limited long ones, like only two AI dramas after a few minutes turn into being a voice over with just pictures and no actual video. It’s so lame. Oh and they refuse to give refunds even when cancelling and requesting it within the first hour of subscribing.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text:
First chosen by the Dragon is what brought me to Muse, I was so bummed when it stopped at 30 episodes so i moved on to another new release only to find that to stops when things start to get good. The stories with full episodes have bad acting and the story lines aren’t really great, I’m trying to get my monies worth by watching what i can but sometimes it hard, i don’t want to start a 3rd incomplete series. I really had high hopes for Muse but unfortunately i’ll need to cancel my subscription. 

I gave it 2 stars because it started off great, but if these AI series don’t come out when it’s time for my subscription to be canceled i’ll come back and change my star rating to 1 star for wasting my time really.

reviews.title: Wish the would finish some of the stories
reviews.text: I liked the stories so i purchased the membership which is like $19 a month and none of the stories i like have been updated. They keep coming out with similar stories line and all stop after 30 episodes and leave you hanging. Its seems as if none of the stories have been written. I’m gonna cancel my subscription if none of the stories have been updated by the end of the month. I wouldn’t recommend this as it is cost the same price as an audible subscription and at least those stories get finished.

reviews.title: Great series options/ Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Unfortunately, the system did not give me the option to leave less than one star because I would’ve left zero if possible! I authorized 2 charges for subscription with my apple device, which anyone who has apple knows when the security function is active you have to personally confirm all purchases as the added step of protecting so random charges aren’t completed. Some how right after the 2nd authorized charges this company without my consent or any Apple transaction records does it show I authorized the third charge, because I didn’t. The company stated since it was done through the platform then I must have accepted the offer, sorry I didn’t!!! The company was adamant on only offering 50% refund for their mistake instead of refunding the entire third unauthorized charge. Due to this, I agreed to take the 50% and notified the company I would be filing a claim through my bank for fraudulent activity without consent. Please make sure you keep an eye on your banking and the charges that are being charged to use so this does not happen to you as well. Needless to say, I canceled all subscriptions and will be going with other platforms that are trustworthy and do not make additional charges without consent.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This app is a scam. I saw a video on Facebook. I wanted to continue to watch. It said it was free and took me to a website. It played a couple of videos, then prompted a purchase for 3 days of access. I paid for the 3 days, but the videos played only a couple of short clips before requiring me to download the app. The videos then became a story narration with AI-generated images (no longer AI-generated acting). I wasn’t interested since that wasn’t what I started watching. Then I saw a recurring charge on my statement. No email, nothing in the app, or on my subscription tab reflected that I signed up for a recurring subscription. I had no way to cancel it because I had nothing that said I subscribed. Please don’t download this app; the videos and their recurring charging practices are a scam.
